# Taskly

A small to-do API for teams. Tasks belong to a team, can have a due date, and
can be shared with teammates.

## Run

```sh
npm install
npm run build
npm start
npm test
```

Set `TASKLY_SNAPSHOT=path/to/snapshot.json` to start with saved data.

## API

| Method | Path | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/tasks` | Tasks you own or that were shared with you |
| POST | `/tasks` | Create a task (`title`, `teamId`, optional `dueDate`) |
| GET | `/tasks/:id` | One task, with its status |
| POST | `/tasks/:id/complete` | Mark a task as done |
| POST | `/tasks/:id/share` | Share a task with a teammate (`userId`) |

Send your user id in the `x-user-id` header.

## Task status

A task is `open`, `done`, `late` (finished after its due date) or `overdue`
(still open after its due date). See `computeTaskStatus` in
`src/services/taskService.ts`.

symbols.doc: /** Formats a timestamp as YYYY-MM-DD in UTC, so every server prints the same date. */

symbols.doc: /** Groups writes for the logs. Writes still apply immediately. */

symbols.name: archiveCompleted
symbols.doc: /** Archives every task of `teams` that was finished before `before`. Returns how many. */

symbols.name: slugify
symbols.doc: /** Turns a title into a URL-friendly slug: "Hello World" becomes "hello-world". */

symbols.name: shareTask
symbols.doc: /** Shares a task with another user. Only team members can share, and finished tasks can't be shared. */

symbols.doc: /** Throws unless `userId` belongs to the task's team. */
